titulo: The reel in 7 steps: plan before the script
hero_alt: A vertical phone on a dark table beside a script divided into seven cards.
lead: r7e gives you the script: seven trigger points, from a hook with a number to a request for comments. It took four batches of reels to reach the r7ex standard: the content worked when the plan came before the script, and the format worked with a TV-news finish. Here you’ll learn the plan, the seven parts, and the speaking rules.
objetivo: write a 30 to 45 s reel in 7 steps based on a plan with an audience, a desire, a hook with a number, a rating, and a destination.

aprende.t: The five fields in the plan, before you write the script
The seven parts, with the real example of the hacker reel
The speaking rules: length, numbers written out, CTA
What the four batches taught us

secoes.titulo: From thesis to reel in r7ex
secoes.sub: Claude writes, Codex designs, HeyGen speaks, and the engine syncs everything with the voice.

nos.detalhe: Person, what they want, a hook with a number or fact, potential rating, and destination on inema.club. Below 7, change the angle or topic before writing any script.
python3 r7ex.py novo <slug> creates the form from the template. You write the plan, opening, seven parts (script, image or screenshot, panel), CTA, and where to publish.
r7ex.py checar requires 7 parts, a script from 550 to 700 characters, and every panel or counter word to appear in that part’s script.
Images by Codex, avatar by the HeyGen studio (only with written approval in APROVADO_HEYGEN), scene, render, and review sheet. You review the opening title and the sheet before sending.
It goes to the bot on Telegram and joins the end of the channel queue (1 every 2 hours). Never upload directly: the queue spaces out posts and gives you time to hold a video.

secoes.legenda: Example from the r7ex repository. For your channel, the order matters: plan → form → gate → media → review → queue.

rolagem_fim.texto: No avatar or render before the plan and the plan sheet gate. The costly parts (avatar, images, render) only start once the cheap part (text) has passed.

secoes.titulo: The 7 parts, in the hacker reel
secoes.sub: Real example from r7ex (published reel). The order of parts 2 to 6 adapts to the topic; there are always seven parts of ~30–40 s.

texto: Fear, something new, or a provocation, with a number or fact. Never defuse the trigger in the same sentence.

exemplo.texto: Hackers broke into OpenCode… US$ 1.700 in one night.

texto: Show why it affects the person watching. You can also use proof: "it’s happened 3 times already".

exemplo.texto: The key is the password the AI uses… yours could be next.

passos.sub: what it looks like if it works
texto: The person imagines being on the other side of the problem.

exemplo.texto: Imagine sleeping easy, knowing that… the loss has a cap.

texto: Answer "I’m not technical" or "I don’t have time" before the person scrolls away.

exemplo.texto: You don’t need to be an expert or a programmer.

texto: This is where you introduce the solution or method, preferably in three items.

exemplo.texto: Three adjustments: a limit, one key per use, an alert…

texto: What life looks like afterward, or "take advantage before…".

exemplo.texto: The scare turns into an alert on your phone…

texto: The fixed closing points to inema.club and asks for a comment. In reel7etapas, the request is "comment WORD"; in r7ex, "ask me for the link".

exemplo.texto: It’s all at inema dot club. Or ask me for the link here in the comments.

secoes.sub: Fill out the plan first. If the score is below 7, change the angle before writing the line.

blocos.conteudo:
# Reel plan

- Person (who's watching): 
- What they want (one sentence: gain something, solve a pain point, reach a desire): 
- Hook (fear, something new, or a provocation, with a number or fact): 
- Source for the number: 
- Potential score (0–10) — "would a stranger stop scrolling here?": 
- Destination (the page that solves it, becomes the proof screenshot):

| # | Part | Line (numbers spelled out) | Screen (image or screenshot + panel) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Hook (trigger + number) | | |
| 2 | Fear or proof | | |
| 3 | Desire | | |
| 4 | Ease | | |
| 5 | Discovery (3 items) | | |
| 6 | Benefit or urgency | | |
| 7 | Comment | It’s all at <your site>. Or ask me for the link here in the comments. | |

Total line: 550 to 700 characters (~30–40 s).

abas.html:
• Batch 1 (hook = promise, blurred photo): no views on TikTok or Instagram.
  • Batch 2 (only the hook became a trigger with a number): better, "still standard".
  • Batch 3 (plan before the line, strong claims, fixed CTA, real screenshots): the content hit the mark.
  • Batch 4, r7ex (same line, TV news finish): the style hit the mark. Standard since 10/18/2026.

Line should be 550 to 700 characters. Spell out numbers and years because the avatar reads them; the captions switch them to numerals. Never make up a number; say "free" only when the page says so.

The plan targets a general audience (AI translated into everyday terms), not a niche, because the reel aims to bring in new people.

exercicios.titulo: E1 · One reel in 7 steps, on paper
exercicios.texto: Fill out plano.md and write a 30- to 45-second reel for your niche using the 7-part template. Read it aloud while timing yourself.
exercicios.pronto: you can read it aloud in under 45 s, the plan scores 7 or higher, and the first sentence grabs attention (following the r7ex standard: the hook uses a number or fact).

secoes.fonte: The original exercise list says “the first sentence already states the benefit.” The r7ex standard (10/18/2026) replaced the benefit with a hook using a number, after batches that got no views. Exercises: jornada-agentes/exercicios/04-redes.md.

secoes.sub: The explanation appears after you answer.

perguntas.p: Your plan scored 5 on “Would a stranger stop scrolling here?” What should you do?
opcoes: Write the script and see how it goes.
Change the angle or topic before writing the script.
perguntas.explica: Below 7, change the angle or topic. The plan is there so you can make mistakes cheaply (in text), not expensively (with the avatar and render).

perguntas.p: Which of these is a hook that follows the r7ex standard?
opcoes: “Hello, today I’m going to talk about security.”
“Comment SECURITY and I’ll send you the link.”
perguntas.explica: Hook = a trigger (fear, news, or provocation) with a number or fact. “Spends less” is a promise, the hook from batch 1, which got no views.

perguntas.p: Why does the script spell out “one thousand seven hundred” instead of “1,700”?
opcoes: Because the avatar reads the script; only the captions switch to numerals.
There’s no need: either way works.
perguntas.explica: The avatar reads the text as written. Spelled out, it’s pronounced correctly; the on-screen caption shows the numeral.

perguntas.p: What did the four batches show?
opcoes: That the content got it right with the plan before the script (batch 3), and the format got it right with the news broadcast polish (batch 4).
That a full-screen avatar goes viral more often.
That you just need to post more times a day.
perguntas.explica: The content and format were corrected in separate batches. r7ex combined the script from batch 3 with the engine from batch 4.
